title: Seven Major Versions Hit RC in One Week
caption:
Seven of my dependencies cut a major release candidate in the last seven days.

Prisma 8, pnpm 12, Vitest 5, Drizzle 1.0, Solid 2, Remix 3, Electron 44. All published to npm since August 12.

I used to upgrade the day an RC dropped. Now I wait for the .1 — I've lost too many evenings being early on someone else's breaking change.

Upgrade now or wait?
